messages:
dena.p: Quick sync — we need to align last-mile readiness signals for the upcoming GA cut. Dropping a concise checklist + owners here. Please ack or add gaps.

joel: On SLA: draft SLA lives in /docs/ga/sla-draft but we still need final p50/p95/p99 numbers and the incident escalation cadence. Who has final sign-off?

samir: I can own SRE signoff. Need telemetry to validate p99 < 120ms at target load (10k qps) and error-rate < 0.5%. Canary planned tomorrow 10:00 PT.

ashley: Support coverage updated for GA week but missing 2 runbook playbooks: billing disputes and quota resets. If someone shares common case examples I'll author them.

dena.p: Adding explicit readiness signals: 
- SLA committed and published (doc + legal)
- Docs: quickstart + admin runbooks + outage policy
- Support: runbooks + oncall roster confirmed
- Monitoring: alerts + SLOs wired into ops dashboard
- Pricing: public page + invoice testcases (2)
- Fallbacks: compatible model variant + routing policy
Please call out owners.

joel: Eng will finalize the SLA wording. Need finance to confirm pricing tiers and replacement costs. Also will prepare a short fallback policy (route to quantized variant) and a compatibility checklist.

ops-bot: Canary job canary-2026 started 2026-03-22T10:00Z — smoke tests: 0 errors, 0 timeouts, avg latency 73ms :white_check_mark:. Full telemetry export available at https://internal.redwood/canary/canary-2026/logs

samir: Quick flag — autoscale burst test hit infra quota at 80% of target, resulting in degraded tail latencies. Filed INF-3247 to request quota bump; temporary mitigation: lower burst cap for GA.

dena.p: Action owners (so we don't lose track):
- SRE (samir): quota bump, canary verification, monitoring alarms
- Eng (joel): SLA final text, fallback routing, compatibility checklist
- Support (ashley): write the two runbooks, confirm oncall escalation steps
- Product (dena.p): pricing pages + publish FAQ
Escalation anchors: oncall -> platform lead -> exec notify. Add exec notify criteria to runbooks.

joel: Monitoring additions: error-budget burn alert at 25%/50%/75% with required owners, model-quality regression alert tied to eval-suite delta > 3% on any key metric. I'll add thresholds to the dashboard.

ashley: Docs checklist: quickstart, supported-variants table, downtime & SLA uplift policy, customer-facing incident template. PMs — are we good to publish these?

dena.p: Accept. Also need a fallback plan if primary model is unavailable: route to `redwood/generic-v1-quant` with a reduced token limit and explanatory response. Suggested snippet for API behavior: 
```
{"notice": "degraded-quality-fallback", "model_routed": "redwood/generic-v1-quant"}
```
Who owns the UX wording?

samir: SRE will operate routing; Eng to produce compatible variants. INF-3250 created for fallback automation.

dena.p: Final ask: react with :thumbsup: when you complete your action and update the GA readiness board (https://confluence.redwood.ai/ga-readiness/signal-checklist). We'll do a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm green-for-GA.

joel: acked. I'll push SLA PR by EOD.

ashley: acked. Starting runbooks now.

samir: acked. Will follow up on INF-3247 and INF-3250.
